initialize_BaseModel: initialize a BaseModel instance with opt config including gpu_ids, isTrain, and checkpoints_dir
save_network_BaseModel: save a PyTorch network state dict to a .pth file using save_network helper
load_network_BaseModel: load a PyTorch network state dict from a .pth file using load_network helper
set_input_BaseModel: set input data on a BaseModel instance using the set_input method
get_current_visuals_BaseModel: retrieve the current input visuals from a BaseModel instance using get_current_visuals
